sec.title: August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 173)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 26** across American network radio, four post-war adventures of *The Lone Ranger* starring Brace Beemer and John Todd for General Mills Cheerios (The Welcome Guest, When the Trapper Was Trapped, Mystery Hotel, and The Sarsaparilla Kid), James Monks as John P. Marquand's sleuth *Mr. I.A. Moto* solving the case of the stolen Ming fan on NBC, and Robert Dryden in *Dark Destiny* (1942–1955):
